g.text: Ridge lowers RMSE by anticipating single 0.1 bar steps and pays on unchanged rows

g.text: Recorded step = (y_t − y_{t−1}) / 0.1 bar on the shared 43,168-row mask (409 segments). Only one tank row changes by 2 increments; none by more. Descriptive, on
